The '''''Acklay''-class mobile fortress''', known less formally as '''Acklay Battle Fortress''', was an underwater [[Walker/Legends|walker]] which acted as a mobile command base for [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]] of [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire]]. The ''Acklay''-class was named after the [[Acklay/Legends|Acklay]] of [[Vendaxa/Legends|Vendaxa]] and apparently modeled after the appearance of the creature.

==Characteristics==
[[File:AcklayBattleFortress.jpg|thumb|left|180px|An Acklay recalling [[Shark underwater fighter|Shark]] subfighters.]]
These large vehicles carried a complement of [[Shark underwater fighter|Shark]] subfighters as well as [[aquatic assault stormtrooper]]s. The [[Hangar/Legends|docking bay]] of the battle fortress was on the belly of the craft, allowing forces of the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]] to exit the vehicle by dropping straight through an open porthole. The docking bay was staffed by a crew of technicians who helped in maintaining the Shark fighters and organizing fuel tanks. The battle fortress was armed with an array of [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]], including a large double cannon that branched off of the elevated [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|bridge]] of the craft.

==History==
The Acklay Battle Fortress was employed during the [[Skirmish on Dac]], where it tracked down [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] refugees and slaughtered them on the orders of [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Darth Krayt]]. The [[Mon Calamari Rangers]], led by [[Imperial Knight]] [[Treis Sinde]] attempted to capture one of the fortresses in order to secure a mobile command base which would strengthen their hit-and-run attacks. One such Acklay Battle Fortress, the ''[[Sea Lion]]'', was commanded by [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Sturves]], who nearly lost his vessel when Sinde infiltrated his ship through the docking bay.

==Behind the scenes==
The ''Acklay''-class mobile fortress was featured in [[Legacy (2006) 32|''Legacy'' (2006) 32]] a [[Star Wars comic books|comic issue]] in ''[[Star Wars: Legacy]]''{{'s}} [[2009]] story arc [[Star Wars: Legacy: Fight Another Day|''Fight Another Day'']].
